scope: disposable local single-node fixture; no production connection or data
environment_constraints: Ordinary sandbox denied the Docker socket; the explicitly local Docker socket succeeded using authorized escalated execution.
No pre-existing Scylla image or fixture was available.
Seastar saw 500000000 physical bytes and rejected the initial 1GiB fixture configuration. The disposable fixture was recreated once at 384MiB and started successfully.

Docker advertised a bridge identity different from the loopback seed. The production host filter correctly rejected it until the fixture's verified local Docker network identity was supplied as LocalAddress; the host filter was not weakened.
